n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: The shelf behind the desk, a fraction too deep. Odalys's copied key fits a knot in the wood.

go.speaker: narrator
go.text: The shelf swings inward on oiled hinges. Violet light. The scratch of a pen that never stops.

day.speaker: narrator
day.text: Ledgers, perfectly kept. The shelf behind the desk is a fraction too deep. A draught comes from it.
